correctness.rationale: The geodesic transport dual reduction is exact. Odd-count lower bound follows from half-integral source split and the unit fiber distance. At even counts the finite assignment LP admits a matching; any two distinct balanced assignments with individual total cost less than one would have combined cost at least two, so a strict subthreshold approximation creates an impossible continuous section of the connected degree-two circle cover. Explicit closed piecewise-linear atom paths meet both bounds. Exact rational diagnostic runs at m=1..20 across 28810 finite assertions corroborate computations but are not the infinite proof.
